_design: NEW FEATURE. Gary's snow export explicitly added log/stump/tuft for desolate winter feel. This is the open-field version (no nearFeature gate = can appear anywhere across snow biome). Distinct from stump_log_litter.json which is forest-nearFeature gated. Mix: fallen logs, dead trees, occasional pine stump. Gives the impression of a forest that has been buried by winter or long-dead.

placement._: Open-field scatter — no nearFeature gate. Spread across snow biome interior. minSpacing 6 means debris reads as isolated fallen pieces, not cluttered.
